result.investigation_summary: The engine reports an unexplained GBP bank-minus-ledger difference of -812.40 across 10 reconciliation dates from 2026-09-17 through 2026-09-30, with each C08 result marked FAIL and NOT_EVIDENCED. A 812.40 debit appears on the 2026-09-17 bank statement, and the engine reports no cash-book or other listed counterpart for it. The records establish the difference and the unmatched entry, but not the debit’s purpose or its relationship to the continuing difference.

confirmed_findings.claim: The engine reports a bank-minus-ledger difference of -812.40, marked FAIL and NOT_EVIDENCED, on all 10 listed reconciliation dates from 2026-09-17 to 2026-09-30.
confirmed_findings.explanation: Each C08 result reports -812.40, with explained_by_timing reported as 0.00 and residual_unexplained as -812.40. The external reconciliation and linked 17:00 confirmation for 2026-09-17 show ledger 341484.46 and bank 340672.06; the corresponding 2026-09-30 records show ledger 395844.86 and bank 395032.46.
confirmed_findings.title: Repeated GBP bank-minus-ledger difference
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: The same reported difference persists across the listed reconciliation dates and remains unexplained in the engine results.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The engine reports -812.40 for each listed date, with no amount explained by timing. The cited records show the reported bank and ledger figures for the first and last dates.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: These records do not establish why the difference arose or whether the 2026-09-17 bank debit explains the difference on later dates.

confirmed_findings.claim: The 2026-09-17 statement includes a 812.40 debit with reference “SETTLE 0417,” for which the engine reports no cash-book counterpart or listed batch, transaction, top-up, or register counterpart.
confirmed_findings.explanation: The bank entry is dated 2026-09-17 at 15:20 and has a D indicator. The BANK-CASH-LINK and C11 control results report the unmatched status.
confirmed_findings.title: Unmatched 2026-09-17 bank debit
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: The entry is present on the bank statement at the date the reported reconciliation difference begins, but no listed internal counterpart is identified.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The cited bank record shows a debit of 812.40 with reference “SETTLE 0417.” The cited engine results report no cash-book counterpart and no listed batch, transaction, top-up, or register counterpart.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: The evidence does not identify the beneficiary, purpose, authorization, accounting treatment, or relationship of this debit to the continuing reconciliation difference.

confirmed_findings.claim: The firm’s internal GBP reconciliation records report requirement and resource as equal on 2026-09-17 and 2026-09-18, while the external reconciliation results report a bank-minus-ledger difference on those dates.
confirmed_findings.explanation: The internal reconciliation records report a difference of 0.00 on both dates. The external reconciliation records compare the account’s reported bank balance with its ledger balance, and the corresponding C08 results report -812.40.
confirmed_findings.title: Different reported internal and external reconciliation results
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: The figures describe different reconciliation views; the internal equality does not remove the separately reported bank-versus-ledger difference.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The internal records report equal requirement and resource on the two cited dates. The external results report a -812.40 bank-minus-ledger difference on those dates.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: The records do not show that the two reconciliation views use identical measures or establish why their reported results differ.

confirmed_findings.claim: The engine reports that the difference was not recorded in the discrepancy log for the 10 reconciliation dates in scope.
confirmed_findings.explanation: The discrepancy-log control result reports 0 log entries and states that investigation evidence is absent; SEARCH-02 found no discrepancy-log entries referencing the listed external reconciliation records.
confirmed_findings.title: No matching discrepancy-log entries found
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: The supplied evidence does not include a recorded investigation trail for the repeated difference.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The engine reports 0 discrepancy-log entries for the in-scope external reconciliation records, and the search result is NOT_FOUND.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: The search does not establish that no investigation or log entry exists outside the supplied data.

hypotheses.possible_explanation: The unmatched debit may be associated with the onset or continuation of the reported difference, but this relationship is unverified.
hypotheses.limitations: The debit’s reference has no other match in SEARCH-01, and the packet explicitly does not link the entry to the difference by amount. No payment support, beneficiary detail, or verified transaction relationship is supplied.
hypotheses.rationale: The debit amount matches the reported difference and it appears on the bank statement for the date the difference first appears; the available records do not verify a link.

missing_evidence.description: No other record carrying the reference “SETTLE 0417” was found in the searched bank, cash-book, settlement, transaction, top-up, or discrepancy-log fields.
missing_evidence.expected_source: Supporting bank payment instruction or remittance detail, beneficiary information, and any matching cash-book, settlement, transaction, top-up, or register record.
missing_evidence.impact: The entry’s purpose and accounting treatment cannot be established, and no verified counterpart is available.

missing_evidence.description: No discrepancy-log entry referencing the in-scope external reconciliation records was found.
missing_evidence.expected_source: The firm’s discrepancy log and contemporaneous investigation or escalation records for the 2026-09-17 through 2026-09-30 differences.
missing_evidence.impact: The supplied evidence does not show whether or how the repeated difference was investigated.

open_questions: Who was the beneficiary of the “SETTLE 0417” debit, and what payment instruction or supporting document authorized or described it?
Was the unmatched debit entered in a record or system not represented in the supplied data?
What records explain how the bank-minus-ledger difference remained -812.40 on each listed reconciliation date?

recommended_next_steps.action: Obtain the bank’s full payment detail and the firm’s underlying payment instruction, beneficiary information, and supporting authorization for the 2026-09-17 debit referenced “SETTLE 0417.”
recommended_next_steps.rationale: These records are needed to identify and substantiate the debit’s purpose.
recommended_next_steps.evidence_needed: Bank remittance or transaction-detail record and the corresponding payment instruction or supporting voucher.

recommended_next_steps.action: Trace the debit against the complete safeguarding cash book and relevant settlement, transaction, top-up, and register records, including any reference variants.
recommended_next_steps.rationale: The supplied searches and controls identify no counterpart, and further records may establish whether the entry was recorded elsewhere.
recommended_next_steps.evidence_needed: Complete dated ledger extracts, supporting journal entries, and relevant settlement or payment-register records for SGA-GBP-01.

recommended_next_steps.action: Obtain the discrepancy log and contemporaneous investigation records for all 10 reported reconciliation dates, then trace the bank and ledger balances across those dates.
recommended_next_steps.rationale: The engine reports the difference repeatedly and reports no matching discrepancy-log entries.
recommended_next_steps.evidence_needed: Discrepancy-log extracts, investigation or escalation records, and dated reconciliation workpapers supporting the bank and ledger figures.
